name: edge-256
description: Hypothetical microcontroller-class NPU sized from public data on the Ethos-U55 top configuration (Arm Ethos-U product brief: 256 MACs, 18 to 50 KB internal SRAM, two 64-bit AXI, throughput quoted at 1 GHz). 16x16 output-stationary array: 256 MAC/cycle, 512 GOP/s at 1 GHz and 2 ops/MAC. SRAM 50 KiB, the top U55 figure. One 64-bit AXI port to system SRAM that holds every tensor (Vela Sram_Only memory mode); rate, latencies and outstanding limits from Vela 5.2.0 Ethos_U55_High_End_Embedded: 8 B/cycle, 32-cycle read and write latency, 4 reads and 4 writes outstanding. Bursts up to 16 beats, the shortest power of two with which 4 outstanding reads cover 32 cycles. Tiles 32x32x128: the largest power-of-two square tile whose two slots of two panel buffers fit with panels at least 32 B deep (Vela Sram_burst_length); the 7936 B left over is the weight cache. Pipeline 4 cycles per panel, the simulator default.
